name: Yuuki Beresford
original_name: ユウキ・べレスフォード
source:
The protagonist and Kazuto's childhood friend.
He was also with the protagonist when she went back to the school and got wrapped up in everything.
He's an easygoing person with a calm disposition, because he grew up in peace he doesn't know much about the world.
translation:
The protagonist and Kazuto's childhood friend.
He was also with the protagonist when she went back to the school and got wrapped up in everything.
He's an easygoing person with a calm disposition, because he grew up in peace he doesn't know much about the world.
